 Save up to 30% on new additions and old favorites. By Alanna Martine Kilkeary November 13, 2026 Courtesy of brands; Alanna Martine Kilkeary; Glamour composite by Jemeria Davison You know what we love about Cyber Week? That you don’t have to wait until the end of November to save money on your beauty faves. Each day brands release more of the best early Black Friday beauty deals, meaning you can already get some truly spectacular savings. As Glamour ’s shopping writer and go-to beauty expert, I’m constantly scouring the internet to bring you the latest and greatest in all things makeup, skin care, hair care, and tools—so trust me when I say these are some incredible early deals on products I’ve tested this year that you won’t want to miss. Deals are already live on some of the best Korean skin care brands (looking at you, Medicube), plus markdowns on top blow-dry brushes , antiaging red-light devices, and LED face masks . We’re also expecting jaw-dropping discounts at Ulta, Nordstrom, Sephora, and more luxury beauty retailers to come.
 Some of the best early bargains so far? The Medicube Firm & Glow Device Duo , which features the brand new Booster Pro 2X device , is marked down to under $240, plus up to 20% off other K-beauty favorites like the Celimax Retinal Shot Tightening Booster . Not to be overlooked, we also found some hot hair-tool deals, including over 20% off on our tried-and-true curling iron, the Hot Tools Professional 1" Extended Barrel Curling Iron . We also saw 30% off one of our go-to blow-dryer brushes , the Bondiboost Infrared Thermal Brush , which will cut your morning get-ready routine in half—seriously.
 Get your holiday shopping done well before the holidays with the most coveted beauty picks from viral brands like Monday Haircare, First Aid Beauty, CurrentBody, Centellian 24, and more, ahead. And check back as we update this page over the coming weeks to give you the best beauty shopping deals as they drop.

 Skip the salon blowout with the best Black Friday hair-tool deals.
 Black Friday is a prime time to reinvest in hair tools or try something new in the at-home tool department. Truth is, a lot of these hairstyling tools —from curling irons to hair straighteners and thermal brushes—can actually give you a salon-worthy, just-got-back-from-a-blowout finish without dropping major cash.
 Sales we’re seeing so far include 25% off a heavy hitter from Hot Tools for the ultimate red-carpet waves and 30% off a titanium blow-dryer brush from L’Ange that will make your strands look as if they grew three sizes. If you’re looking to cut back on your styling time, we love the Bondiboost Infrared Thermal Brush, which is marked down to just $88 compared to its usual $125. It’s gentle on all hair types, and creates volume and waves on even the most flat, limp strands.

 Curious about skin antiaging and face-lifting devices ? Now’s the time to add one to your stash, as popular gadgets that feature microcurrent and red-light-therapy technology are also marked down early for Black Friday. Standouts include the Medicube Firm & Glow Device Duo, which you can now add to cart for under $240. The gift set features the brand’s new Medicube Booster Pro 2X, which uses gentle electrical impulses to sculpt contours and enhance the efficacy of your skin products, plus light therapy to even out discoloration and smooth fine lines. After use, you’ll see a noticeable difference in the elasticity of your skin, as well as a more even texture, tone, and a healthy glow.

 You can also take $75 off Solawave’s red-light-therapy mask and its face and neck Lightboost serum. The duo makes for a great at-home antiaging treatment—four light settings—amber, red light, deep red, and near-infrared—penetrate into the skin at different levels to target dark spots, fine lines, wrinkles, and creases. If you’re in the market for an upgraded facial hair removal tool , there’s discounts on those too. The Michael Todd Beauty Sonicsmooth Dermaplane Razor is marked down to under $100, a steal for an exfoliating face shaver that can remove peach fuzz and dull, dead skin skin. CurrentBody is already showing Black Friday love with 10% off its brand new Series 3 face mask and neck mask for under $1,000.

 Get glass skin with the best Black Friday Korean beauty deals.
 Korean skin care products are best known for delivering a glowing, plumped, practically poreless finish called glass skin. They achieve this with a mix of soothing ingredients that comfort and promote skin health: from Centella asiatica (a.k.a. cica) to soothe redness and inflammation to PDRN to help reinforce the skin barrier. Korean brands also notoriously have some great sales during Black Friday, and we’ve already spotted some great deals. TikTok-viral Centellian 24 Madeca Cream Time Reverse is on sale for under $30; this powerhouse concoction serves as one of the best antiaging creams out there to help smooth rough skin texture, deeply hydrate, and give you a glassy, fresh and bouncy finish.

 Medicube’s PDRN Pink Collagen Capsule Cream is also marked down to under $20 and makes for a perfect moisturizer restock if you’re looking for something to give dull, dry, and cracked skin a boost, especially during this transitional time of year as temperatures fall and you can’t escape the dry air. If you’re new to Korean skin care, we recommend trying a K-beauty face mask to get you hooked. One of our favorites from Medihela is discounted—it features niacinamide, panthenol, and hyaluronic acid to calm and soothe inflammation and redness caused by acne and dryness. Mix all that with some great picks from Celimax, VT Cosmetics, and Dr. Melaxin, and you have a whole cart of Korean beauty picks to level up your everyday routine (you can thank us later!).

 Soften fine lines with the best Black Friday skin care deals.
 If you’re running low on everyday staples like toners or night creams, now is the best time to stock back up. There are some eye-popping savings on all your favorite skin saviors. Some deals of note include the First Aid Beauty Acne Treatment Pads, which are marked down to under $35. These pimple-zapping toner pads are a must try if you want something to get rid of pimples fast. A change in season also means it’s time to upgrade your night cream and facial moisturizer to richer formulas that combat drier weather. We’re finding some fab early Black Friday deals on those, too, with 10% off the Olay Regenerist Micro-Sculpting Cream and 30% off The INKEY List Peptide Moisturizer. Both formulas work to boost skin hydration, and plump and firm skin for a refreshed, bouncy complexion in the a.m.
 Serums, treatments, and exfoliators are also on major sale, with Eqqualberry’s bestselling NAD+ Peptide Serum and the Elemis Dynamic Resurfacing Facial Pads both offering big discounts. We didn’t forget about body care, either. You can pick up the luscious EOS Shea Butter Body Lotion for under $10—for a 16-ounce bottle!

 Score a good hair day with the best Black Friday hair care deals
 Your hair routine deserves an upgrade, and Black Friday is the best time to try something new. There are some noteable early deals already on cult-favorite brands that you won’t want to miss. Upgrade your washday with Monday Haircare’s Volume Shampoo and Conditioner set, now marked down to just $12. If you’re struggling with a ton of breakage and split ends, grab the OGX Nourishing + Coconut Milk Anti-Breakage Serum for just $8. For thinning hair that needs a little boost and body, Glamour editors are adding the Mielle Organics Rosemary Mint Scalp & Hair Strengthening Oil to cart—it’s under $10 and will create thicker, fuller-bodied strands you can feel.

 Add youthful glow to your makeup routine with these picks
 Whether you’re holiday shopping for mom or looking to shake up your current makeup routine, we’re fans of some already marked-down makeup products from Bobbi Brown, Rodan + Fields, and more. Take 25% off Bobbi Brown’s iconic Long-Wear Cream Shadow Stick—perfect for adding some color and sparkle to your lids with stunning metallic hues. Maybelline’s Sky High Mascara is now marked down to just $10 and makes a perfect stocking stuffer for just about any beauty lover. You can also score 50% off Laura Geller’s marbelized highlighter and 30% off the Rodan + Fields Brow Defining Boost Gel. Snag them all and you have a simple, glowy makeup routine that you can rock everyday—the ultimate beauty gift.
